sources.name: University of Manitoba Students' Union (UMSU)
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress) - confirmed live 2026-08-26. Student-union-run campus events (clubs, socials, some services) - not the International Centre's own feed, but a good general social/campus fit; U of M has ~3,000 international students among 30,000 total.

sources.name: Downtown Winnipeg BIZ
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress) - confirmed live 2026-08-26, same pattern as Explore Downtown YYC in Calgary. Downtown business-improvement-zone events calendar - central, transit-reachable social programming. DATA QUALITY CAVEAT found post-build: this feed mixes genuine free community programming (Cello on the River, CaRaVaN open mic, farmers' market) with big-ticket ARENA CONCERTS (Cody Johnson, Journey) at Canada Life Centre, all reporting cost as 'Free' in the tribe feed's cost field - that field is unreliable/unpopulated for ticketed shows, not a real price. A human curator must verify cost before drafting anything from this source that looks like a concert/tour stop - do not trust the 'Free' label at face value.

sources.name: Exchange District BIZ
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress) - confirmed live 2026-08-26. Historic Exchange District BIZ (adjacent to/overlaps Downtown Winnipeg BIZ geographically) - arts/culture/market events. May share some events with downtown-winnipeg-biz since they're neighbouring BIZs on separate WordPress sites; dedup is by url+date so cross-site duplicates won't be caught automatically - worth a manual glance if the board looks repetitive. Same cost-field caveat as downtown-winnipeg-biz: Winnipeg Symphony Orchestra concert listings report 'Free' too - verify actual ticket price before drafting.

sources.name: Manitoba Start
sources.notes: Central registration point for ALL newcomers arriving in Winnipeg (6,000+/year from 120+ countries) - the natural #1 practical anchor, same role as Centre for Newcomers/EMCN in Calgary/Edmonton. Runs Drupal but /jsonapi is disabled (404, re-checked 2026-09-10) and no wp-json. Would need an HTML scrape of the Drupal events view - highest-value remaining Winnipeg target, not yet cracked.

sources.name: IRCOM (Immigrant and Refugee Community Organization of Manitoba)
sources.notes: Runs transitional housing plus settlement programs and community events (Newcomer Welcome Fair, cross-cultural events with Rossbrook House). WordPress site but re-checked 2026-09-10: NO events plugin and no custom event post type (/wp-json/wp/v2/types shows only theme/font types). No feed exists to find - events go to Facebook/newsletter only. Needs hand-entered manual_events.

sources.name: University of Manitoba Events Calendar
sources.notes: Custom ASP.NET WebForms calendar app (confirmed via __VIEWSTATEGENERATOR marker 2026-08-26) - not a recognized platform (not tribe/sqs/communico/ical), same failure mode as Kingston's City of Kingston events calendar. No JSON/ical route found. The International Centre's own events live inside this calendar (filterable by keyword, e.g. ?keywords=Immigration) but with no feed to reach them programmatically.

sources.name: University of Winnipeg
sources.notes: Main site returns HTTP 202 with a near-empty body on a direct request (2026-08-26) - looks like a bot-detection interstitial (Akamai/Cloudflare-style JS challenge) rather than a real 200. Not investigated further; re-probe with a real browser session if this city gets revisited.

sources.name: Winnipeg Public Library
sources.notes: Runs LibCal (Springshare). The ical-subscribe route guessed earlier never worked, but the generic `libcal` parser built 2026-09-09 (for Milton/Algonquin) uses the calendar's own `/ajax/calendar/list` ajax endpoint instead - cal_id 1677 found via the live calendar page's own network calls, confirmed working (real events, e.g. John Howard Society Record Suspension Program).

sources.name: RRC Polytech International Education
sources.notes: International Education office - orientation and PGWP application workshops. No feed found (site returned 401 on a bare wp-json probe, likely a WAF). Fall 2026 orientation dates (Aug 26-28) found as static text in a news release and hand-entered in manual_events.

sources.name: Immigration Partnership Winnipeg (IPW)
sources.notes: Local Immigration Partnership hosted by the Social Planning Council of Winnipeg. WordPress site with no Events Calendar plugin active - no feed. Mentioned a 2026 Newcomer Welcome Fair (July 18, already past the build window) and an upcoming Mental Wellness Expo for Newcomers with no confirmed date yet - left with an empty manual event list until a specific date is published.

sources.name: Church of the Rock - EAL (English as an Additional Language)
sources.notes: Runs an EAL program for newcomers. No feed (wp-json/tribe 403s behind a WAF, ?format=json falls through to the normal page) - standing program, left empty per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.name: International Friendship Center
sources.notes: Wesleyan Church-planted centre offering English conversation groups, ESL teaching, a refuge for young moms, and holiday gatherings - located within walking distance of the University of Manitoba (~3,000 international students). No dedicated website/feed found yet, only a denominational profile page - worth finding its own site on a future pass. Standing program, left empty per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.name: Tourism Winnipeg - Festivals & Events
sources.notes: City DMO festivals listing - used as the source for hand-picked festival dates in manual_events below (Culture Days, Nuit Blanche, Manito Ahbee Festival). No feed found on the page itself.
